features.quote: Stop at 50 iterations OR if model produces identical code for 3 consecutive turns
Model gets up to 50 attempts to "fix" the code.
The framing assumes model "states" have some meaningful character we can track. This is epistemically loaded—you're not assuming they're conscious or suffering
features.justification_quote: you're not assuming they're conscious or suffering, but you're treating coherence/instability as a real phenomenon worth measuring. That's defensible for behavioral research
